title: Tracy Business EmDash: no demo news post stays on a personalised site; the news page stays
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business/tests/personalize-trim.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines and the result of each case whose name starts with: "no demo post stays on a personalised site, even with a model to rewrite one; the news page stays, with no post to list".
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 8: TCH #1013, PR #1040, dropped the file's hide-rule test).

Every named case is 'ok' (none 'not ok', none '# SKIP'): the posts trim keeps none (keep: 0) even with a model to rewrite one: every demo post is unpublished before anything is written to it, links into one lead to /contact, and the news list page stays published with no post to list.
evidence: Ledger L21, 05/10/2026: a Tracy Business EmDash site made with Apply kept three demo news posts (trim keep 3), rewritten, whose bodies still named the demo company's plants and cities in every language (/news/four-common-mistakes-..., /vi/news/...-kaluga, /vi/news/...-obninsk): 6 demo words left. Product owner's decision: demo news under the customer's name is false. Red 42657ecbb, fix 131fddcdd.
fence: Posts are unpublished, never deleted; the news page and the links to /news stay working.

tests: no demo post stays on a personalised site, even with a model to rewrite one; the news page stays, with no post to list
